description: A.T. Gunadheera and Another v. J.H. Daisy Jayakuru and Another A.T. Gunadheera and Another v. J.H. Daisy Jayakuru and Another View More before Hon. Anil Gooneratne, J.
parties: A.T. Gunadheera and Another v. J.H. Daisy Jayakuru and Another A.T. Gunadheera and Another v. J.H. Daisy Jayakuru and Another View More
keywords: Action for declaration of title and ejectment, akin to rei vindicatio; Petitioner must succeed on strength of own title; chain of title in deed found illegible and its extent did not tally with subsequent deed of declaration; Respondents\' claim to title also unproven; District Judge\'s finding on possession undisturbed. Held - District Court judgment set aside and case sent back for re-trial due to unresolved discrepancy in extent of title.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Section 154 of the Civil Procedure Code
